html:
G'oya

Bu "orollar" (gaps and islands) masalasi. Kuryerning ish kunlarini tartib bilan raqamlaymiz: 1, 2, 3... Ketma-ket kunlarda sana ham, raqam ham bittaga o'sadi, demak sana - raqam o'zgarmaydi. Kun tushib qolganda sana ikkiga sakraydi, raqam esa bittaga, va ayirma o'zgaradi. Shu ayirma bo'yicha guruhlasak, har guruh bitta seriya bo'ladi.

Yechim

Faqat PostgreSQLWITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT courier_id, order_date
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'delivered'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT courier_id,
         order_date - CAST(ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY courier_id
                                              ORDER BY order_date) AS INTEGER) AS g
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT courier_id, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY courier_id, g
)
SELECT c.id AS courier_id, c.name, COALESCE(MAX(s.len), 0) AS longest_streak
FROM couriers c
LEFT JOIN streaks s ON s.courier_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id

Namunadagi Aziz: 29-aprel (1), 30-aprel (2), 1-may (3), 2-may (4) uchun ayirma bir xil, 28-aprel. 4-may (5) va 5-may (6) uchun esa 29-aprel. Ikki seriya, uzunligi 4 va 2.

PostgreSQL'da sanadan butun son ayirsa bo'ladi, ROW_NUMBER esa bigint qaytaradi, shuning uchun CAST. SQLite'da sana matn, uni julianday bilan kun raqamiga aylantiramiz:

Faqat SQLiteWITH days AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT courier_id, order_date
  FROM orders
  WHERE status = 'delivered'
),
grp AS (
  SELECT courier_id,
         julianday(order_date) - ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY courier_id
                                                   ORDER BY order_date) AS g
  FROM days
),
streaks AS (
  SELECT courier_id, COUNT(*) AS len
  FROM grp
  GROUP BY courier_id, g
)
SELECT c.id AS courier_id, c.name, COALESCE(MAX(s.len), 0) AS longest_streak
FROM couriers c
LEFT JOIN streaks s ON s.courier_id = c.id
GROUP BY c.id, c.name
ORDER BY c.id

Tuzoqlar

DISTINCT shart. Azizning 30-aprelda ikki buyurtmasi bor. Ular raqamlanganda raqam ikki marta o'sadi, sana esa joyida turadi, va bitta seriya ikkiga bo'linadi. DENSE_RANK bilan bu muammo teskarisiga aylanadi: takror kunlar bitta raqam oladi, lekin COUNT(*) ularni ikki marta sanaydi.

Kunning oydagi raqami (EXTRACT(DAY ...)) oy almashganda buziladi: 31 dan 1 ga tushadi.

Hech qachon ishlamagan kuryer LEFT JOIN bilan qoladi, MAX esa unga NULL beradi. Shart bo'yicha 0 kerak, shuning uchun COALESCE.

Boshqa yo'l

Seriya boshini LAG bilan belgilash mumkin: oldingi ish kuni kechagi kun bo'lmasa, yangi seriya boshlanadi. Belgilarning o'sib boruvchi yig'indisi seriya raqamini beradi. Bu usul uzunroq, lekin tushunish osonroq va "ikki kunlik tanaffusga ruxsat" kabi o'zgarishlarga moslashtirish qulay.
